description: The Department of Statistics of St Kitts and Nevis publishes the housing results of its May 2011 Population and Housing Census as a set of 28 web tables on its Housing Stock topic page. Tables give counts or percentages by parish, nine on St Kitts and five on Nevis, with island and federation totals. Building tables cover dwelling units by roof material, with sheet metal, shingle and concrete columns, by outer wall material, by year built and by rooms. Service tables cover households by light source, where 96.8 percent used public electricity across the federation, water supply, drinking water source, toilet type, cooking fuel and garbage disposal. One table counts households with and without home insurance in each parish, which is rare in census releases and useful for hurricane loss studies. Coverage is national. Format and access: plain HTML tables with no download button; the light source table is dated July 2021. Licence (read on the provider page on 2026-09-28): St Kitts and Nevis Department of Statistics Open Licence Agreement. Caveats: data are from 2011; the 2021 census page describes the operation but no 2021 housing tables were found. Simulation uses: roof and wall exposure by parish for hurricane damage models and service access for utility planning. Related records: the CCRIF St Kitts and Nevis country risk profile.
